paraphrase: Encoding independence: the q.94 moral-error and correction-needed readings plus a fixed-privation evil/truth test admit two interpretations on literally identical non-explanatory data, one with each semantic explanatory order and not the reverse. Both satisfy the explicit asymmetry condition and the purposes-to-competence explanation. Moral error and the evil premise are derived in every practice. This does not establish philosophical compatibility of full worldviews, defend quasi-realist grounding, or refute either order.
